diagnosis.verdict_failure: The v1 schema validated field types but could not enforce the cross-field invariant that accept requires all checks true and no reason codes. The v1 controller rejected two contradictory but structurally valid verdicts as sample failures.
diagnosis.budget_failure: The v1 controller exposed the entire remaining cumulative output budget to each turn. On the failing APD item, contract and first solver calls consumed 13,986 and 16,311 output tokens, leaving 1,709 for the verifier, which ended incomplete at the ceiling.

versioned_changes.from: prompt-level instruction plus post-parse rejection of inconsistent accept
versioned_changes.to: explicit iff instruction plus conservative deterministic normalization
versioned_changes.behavior: An accept with any false check or any reason code is downgraded to human_review. A human_review without a reason receives a controller reason code.
guardrails: the raw verdict is retained in verifier_raw_verdict
the effective verdict is retained separately in verifier_verdict
normalization can only preserve or reduce acceptance; it cannot promote human_review to accept
the candidate answer and program are never rewritten

versioned_changes.from: every turn receives all remaining tokens from one 32,768-token cumulative pool
versioned_changes.to: fixed per-turn caps summing to the unchanged 32,768-token pool
versioned_changes.rationale: Prevent early roles from exhausting the final verifier budget while keeping the B1-comparable cumulative ceiling unchanged.

changes: The contract agent is instructed to populate the schema directly and concisely without prolonged analysis.
The solver is instructed to call calculate_finqa directly on its tool-enabled turn without narrated or extended analysis.
The verifier is instructed to evaluate checks first and apply the accept iff invariant without narrated analysis.
versioned_changes.purpose: Reduce pathological hidden-reasoning consumption observed in the parent run.

changes: record requested_max_output_tokens on every model-call trace
record role_output_token_caps in run inputs and reports

frozen_factors.reasoning_configuration: provider default; no reasoning field is sent
frozen_factors.temperature_configuration: provider default; no temperature field is sent

interpretation_boundary.effect_of_semantic_normalization: may convert v1 sample errors into explicit human_review outputs and therefore changes coverage accounting; it does not improve a candidate answer
interpretation_boundary.effect_of_role_caps: controls resource allocation but may expose an earlier-role output ceiling; live completion must be tested
